blocks.text: Annecy is often called the 'Venice of the Alps' thanks to the canals that wind through its old town, all set against the turquoise waters of Lake Annecy and a backdrop of the French Alps.
I spent the afternoon strolling past the medieval Palais de l'Isle, a former prison built on a small island in the Thiou canal, before relaxing on the lakeshore in the late summer sun.
